title: 第339章 无语第338章 让座
slug: 以下犯上徒弟着实貌美
lines: 白望舒的脸更白了，像是被人从里头抽走了所有血色。
他的目光死死盯在龙颜和凤璟身上，嘴唇微微发抖，指尖扣着桌沿，指节泛出青白色。
白恒皱着眉，手搭在白望舒肩上，用了些力道：“舒儿，你认识他们？”
白望舒没有回答。
他当然认识。
冥尊。
判官。
那是阴司里最古老的存在之一，比此方世界绝大多数生灵都要古老。
他不小心误入冥府时，曾被他们相救。
金衣者掌生，红衣者判死，无论你在阳间是什么身份、什么修为，到了他们面前，都不过是生死簿上一个名字。
而现在，这两个传说中的人物，正挤在白恒和叶知秋之间，一个夹着红烧肉，一个端着茶杯，笑眯眯地……蹭饭。
白望舒深吸一口气，努力让自己的声音听起来平稳一些：“在下……见过二位冥主。”
龙颜夹着那块红烧肉，闻言抬起头，桃花眼里漾着几分促狭的笑意，语气却懒洋洋的：“哎呀，都说了是客人，别这么见外嘛。”
凤璟放下茶杯，面色温润如常，朝白望舒微微颔首，声音不高不低：“不必多礼。
今日只吃饭，不谈公务。”
白望舒：……
不谈公务？
你们两个阴司大佬挤在人家饭桌上，跟一群活人抢红烧肉，这叫不谈公务？
他心里这么想，嘴上却一个字都不敢说，只是僵硬地点了点头，收回目光，端起面前的茶杯猛灌了一口。
滚烫的茶水烫得他舌尖一麻，却也让他从那种被阴司气息笼罩的压迫感中回过神来。
赵归涯看着白望舒那副如坐针毡的模样，金色的横瞳里漾着几分幸灾乐祸的光，语气却淡淡的：“说了别吓他，汝等非不听。”
龙颜咬着红烧肉，腮帮子鼓鼓的，含混不清地说：“魅师，我们真没吓他。”
凤璟也点了点头，语气诚恳：“是白公子自己认出来的。”
“所以他们到底是谁？怎么有点眼熟。”
楚安芷对着赵归涯咬耳朵。
赵归涯撇嘴：“能不眼熟嘛，拿链子把我捅对穿的就是这两货”
楚安芷握着筷子的手猛地一紧，转头看向赵归涯，眼底翻涌着浓烈的情绪：“什么？”
赵归涯被她这一声“什么”
吓得肩膀微微一缩，随即又恢复了那副吊儿郎当的模样，摆了摆手：“哎呀，都过去了，你看我现在不是好好的吗？”
楚安芷没有接话，目光从赵归涯身上移开，落在龙颜和凤璟身上，那双平静的眼眸此刻像是结了冰。
龙颜咬着灵蔬的动作微微一顿，桃花眼眨了眨，无辜地看向楚安芷：“师娘，那都是公务，公务你懂吧？我们也是奉命行事。”
楚安芷握着筷子的手又紧了几分，指节泛出青白。
“奉命？”
她的声音不高不低，语气也平静得不像是在质问，可偏偏是这种平静，让龙颜夹菜的动作僵在了半空，“奉谁的命？”
龙颜眨眨眼，桃花眼里的笑意收敛了几分，下意识地看向赵归涯。
赵归涯正端着酒杯喝酒，察觉到龙颜的目光，动作微微一顿，放下酒杯，伸手拍了拍楚安芷的手背：“都说了是公务，你别急。”
content_en:
Bai Wangshu's face turned even paler, as if someone had drained all the blood from it.
His eyes were fixed on Long Yan and Feng Jing, his lips were trembling slightly, his fingertips were clasped on the edge of the table, and his knuckles turned blue-white.
Bai Heng frowned, put his hand on Bai Wangshu's shoulder, and said with some force: "Shu'er, do you know them?"
Bai Wangshu didn't answer.
Of course he does.
Ming Zun.
Judge.
That is one of the oldest existences in the underworld, older than most living things in this world.
He was rescued by them when he accidentally entered the underworld.
Those in gold are given life in the palm of their hands, while those in red are sentenced to death. No matter what your identity or cultivation level is in the world, in front of them, you are just a name on the book of life and death.
And now, these two legendary figures were squeezed between Bai Heng and Ye Zhiqiu, one holding braised pork and the other holding a teacup, smiling... eating.
Bai Wangshu took a deep breath and tried to make his voice sound calmer: "I... have met the two Underworld Lords."
Long Yan held the piece of braised pork between his hands and raised his head when he heard the words. There was a narrow smile in his peach blossom eyes, but his tone was lazy: "Oh, I told you that you are a guest, don't be so outgoing."
Feng Jing put down the tea cup, her face was as gentle as usual, she nodded slightly towards Bai Wangshu, her voice was neither high nor low: "No need to be polite.
Today we will just eat and not talk about official business. "
Bai Wangshu:......
Not talking about official business?
You two gangsters crowded into someone else's dining table and fought for braised pork with a group of living people. Is this called not discussing official business?
He thought so in his heart, but he didn't dare to say a word. He just nodded stiffly, looked back, picked up the teacup in front of him and took a sip.
The scalding tea made the tip of his tongue numb, but it also brought him back to consciousness from the oppressive feeling enveloped by the aura of the underworld.
Zhao Guiya looked at Bai Wangshu who was sitting on pins and needles, his golden pupils were filled with a bit of schadenfreude, but his tone was light: "I told you not to scare him, you will not listen."
Long Yan bit into the braised pork, his cheeks bulging, and he said vaguely: "Master Mei, we really didn't scare him."
Feng Jing also nodded and said in a sincere tone: "Mr. Bai recognized it himself."
"So who are they? Why do they look familiar?"
Chu Anzhi bit her ear at Zhao Guiya.
Zhao Guiya curled his lips and said, "Doesn't this look familiar to you? They were the ones who stabbed me with a chain and put it on."
Chu Anzhi's hand holding the chopsticks tightened suddenly, and she turned to look at Zhao Guiya, with strong emotions surging in her eyes: "What?"
Zhao Guiya was shocked by her "What?"
His shoulders shrank slightly in fear, and then he returned to his careless look, waving his hands: "Oh, it's all over. Don't you think I'm fine now?"
Chu Anzhi did not answer, her eyes moved away from Zhao Guiya and fell on Long Yan and Feng Jing. Those calm eyes seemed to be frozen at the moment.
Long Yan paused slightly while biting the spiritual vegetables, blinked his peach blossom eyes, and looked at Chu Anzhi innocently: "Master's wife, it's all official business. Do you understand official business? We are also following orders."
Chu Anzhi's hand holding the chopsticks tightened a little more, and her knuckles turned blue and white.
"On orders?"
Her voice was neither high nor low, and her tone was so calm that it didn't look like she was questioning. But it was this calmness that made Long Yan freeze in mid-air while picking up vegetables, "Whose order?"
Long Yan blinked, the smile in his peach blossom eyes faded a bit, and he subconsciously looked at Zhao Guiya.
Zhao Guiya was drinking from a wine glass. When he noticed Long Yan's gaze, he paused slightly, put down the wine glass, reached out and patted the back of Chu Anzhi's hand: "I said it was official business, don't be impatient."
